MANISH WAGHODKAR Mumbai, India | +91 7559472402 |manishwaghodkar456@gmail.com

| linkedin.com/in/manish-waghodkar

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Middle Office / Investment Operations professional with 3+ years supporting the full equity trade lifecycle — trade settlement, corporate actions, cash and position reconciliation, and exception/incident resolution — across broking and securities firms. Proven track record driving root cause analysis and control improvements while coordinating across trading, compliance, and depository/custodian teams to resolve time-sensitive breaks and settlement issues. Consistently maintained 99% accuracy across settlement and reconciliation processes handling high-volume, time-sensitive data. CIBOP and NISM-certified across securities operations, equity derivatives, and mutual fund distribution, with hands-on exposure to listed and OTC products.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Equity Trade Lifecycle Trade Settlement & Confirmation (NSE/BSE) Corporate Actions (Dividends, Splits, Mergers) Settlement Fails & Exception Management Cash & Position Reconciliation Portfolio Reconciliation

Incident & Control Management Root Cause Analysis & Issue Escalation Audit & Oversight Controls Cross-Functional Stakeholder Coordination Process Documentation & Playbooks Trade Life Cycle (TLC) Management

Tools & Products Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP) Equity Derivatives, Fixed Income, Forex, Swaps Listed & OTC Products MTF, SLB & CUSPA Operations

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Executive – Operations Way2Wealth Brokers Private Limited, Mumbai

Aug 2026 – Present

Act as a key point of contact for margin pledge, unpledge, and repledge exceptions, coordinating with clearing corporations and internal stakeholders to keep collateral positions accurate and audit-ready.

Own resolution of unpaid MTF (Margin Trading Facility) exceptions, tracking funded positions end-to-end and driving timely recovery actions to prevent downstream settlement risk.



Investigate and resolve inward shortage and SLB (Securities Lending & Borrowing) early pay-in cases, partnering with depositories and counterparties to close breaks within tight settlement timelines.

Manage CUSPA pay-in/pay-out and daily pay-in checks, proactively flagging exceptions ahead of settlement cut-offs to minimize fails and maintain control integrity.

Coordinate mutual fund unit invocation-cum-redemption processing across teams, ensuring accurate, compliant execution and clear communication with stakeholders on status and exceptions.

Associate – Market Operations Yes Securities Limited, Mumbai

Jul 2024 – Dec 2025

Monitored start-of-day settlement readiness across NSE/BSE, identifying cash/position breaks and driving same-day resolution to ensure accurate pay-in/pay-out within T+1 cycles.

Reconciled equity positions daily against NSDL/CDSL depository records and custodians, investigating short deliveries, auction cases, and settlement mismatches to root cause and closure.

Reviewed trade confirmations to flag potential settlement failures early, coordinating across internal teams and external counterparties to resolve issues before they escalated.

Tracked corporate action events — dividends, mergers, stock splits — end-to-end, ensuring timely and accurate capture in client accounts to avoid downstream valuation or entitlement breaks.

Maintained 99% accuracy across settlement and reconciliation processes; built Excel-based tracking (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP) to monitor exception volumes and turnaround times.

Assistant Manager – Operations Kotak Securities Limited, Mumbai

Dec 2022 – Jul 2024

• Owned end-to-end equity settlement operations across cash and F&O segments, ensuring smooth trade execution and

settlement within exchange-mandated timelines.

Handled DP-level operations including securities pay-in/pay-out, margin pledge/unpledge, and resolution of settlement shortages and auction obligations, serving as first point of escalation for exceptions.

Coordinated with internal departments and external counterparties to research and resolve operational issues with urgency, escalating to team leaders and contributing to post-issue process fixes.

Reduced reporting errors through rigorous data validation, quality checks, and process-driven controls, sustaining 99% accuracy across client portfolios.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) VIVA College, University of Mumbai — Mumbai, India

2018 – 2021

Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) VIVA College, University of Mumbai — Mumbai, India

2016 – 2018

Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Nutun Vidyalaya High School — Mumbai, India

2015 – 2016

CERTIFICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

CIBOP – Certified Investment Banking and Operations Professional, Imarticus Learning • NISM Series VII – Securities Operations & Risk Management Certification • NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives Certification Examination • NISM Series V-A – Mutual Fund Distributors Certification Examination
